description:
The purpose is to train 60+ youth from low-income communities to become ﬁrst-generation media and communications professionals through Nazaria’s Basti Media School with a target placement rate of at least 85%.
The 6-month training in Brand Communications, Workplace Readiness, Industry Mentorship, and internship placements.
The funding will support industry training, internships, career placement, and a digital marketplace for NGO comms that connects graduates to paid freelance opportunities, enabling sustainable livelihoods and target incomes of ₹20,000+ per month.

The project will also support the creation of Daan Utsav Media Kits for 10+ grassroots nonproﬁts and place trained youth as media interns with 30 nonproﬁts associated with Rotary Queen’s Necklace.

The project will be inaugurated on 8th October 2026.

Project cost Rs 10 lakhs.
